bagPolicy.summary: All bags are subject to search at Ryman Auditorium. Oversized bags and backpacks are prohibited.
prohibited: Cameras with telephoto or zoom lenses
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Self-parking is available directly across the street at Fifth + Broadway. Parking can be purchased upon entering the garage. The Ryman does not have a public parking lot.

rideshare.note: Lyft is the official rideshare partner of Ryman Auditorium.

concessions.note: Ryman Auditorium offers a variety of concessions including popcorn, candy, and pretzels available in the lobby on each floor. Fully stocked bars are also available for drinks. Nearby, Ole Red and Category 10 provide additional dining and entertainment options with live music and unique experiences.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair-accessible seating is offered for every public event on the Main Floor and Balcony; buy it through AXS or at the AXS Box Office and note your seating needs. Each accessible seat comes with one adjacent companion seat. A lobby elevator reaches the balcony, and wheelchair storage is available if you move to your seat.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Ryman Auditorium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: You can buy tickets through AXS or in person at the AXS Box Office at the Ryman or the Grand Ole Opry House Box Office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The entrance is on the Fourth Avenue side of the building.
